I believe the company had a target of reaching a revenue of INR500 crores.
Growth & demand: Our international business strategy has yielded new product approvals and registrations across new markets that includes French West Africa, Philippines etc.
So what we understand is the growth will be around 25 %-30% on year-on-year.
So my last question is like you told that you were expecting around 20 % to 25% growth in FY ‘25 over FY ‘24.

And we'll be almost maintaining or improving the EBITDA margin of 18% -22% around -- between 18%-22%.
